title: Mango Lime Sorbet
summary: Ripe mango blended with lime and a light sugar syrup, chilled overnight and churned into a smooth, vivid orange sorbet.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Blend the fruit
steps.text: Purée the mango, lime juice and corn syrup in the blender until completely smooth.

steps.title: Add the syrup
steps.text: Warm the sugar and water in the small pan just until the sugar dissolves, then pour it into the blender and blend briefly.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.text: Transfer to a covered container and refrigerate overnight. Put the freezer container in the freezer at the same time.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Blend the purée again for 1 min to lighten it, then churn for about 25 min until thick.

steps.title: Firm up
steps.text: Pack into the cold container and freeze for at least 2 h. If it has frozen hard, soften it in the fridge for 20-30 min before scooping.

tips: Choose very ripe, fragrant mangoes with no stringy fibres; Alphonso or Ataulfo are ideal.
Frozen mango works too; thaw it before blending.
Taste before chilling: if the mango is very sweet, add a little more lime.
storage: Keep frozen and covered for up to 2 weeks.
